messages:
amy: Quick sync — ran end-to-end perf for redwood-30b across regions. Need recommendations for Dedicated pool sizing (GPU count + per-GPU concurrency) and autoscale headroom. Summary below, pinging eng infra + ml ops.

chao: Raw CSV from the benchmark harness (seq_len=256 or 512 depending):
```
model,region,gpu,q,seq,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_s,concurrency
redwood-30b,us-west1,A100-80G,fp16,256,58,120,860,8
redwood-30b,us-west1,A100-80G,int8,256,52,105,980,10
redwood-30b,eu-west1,H100-80G,fp16,256,40,85,1250,12
redwood-30b,eu-west1,H100-80G,int8,256,40,90,1280,14
redwood-30b,us-central1,A10G,int8,256,120,300,320,4
redwood-30b,us-west1,A100-80G,fp16,512,110,260,420,4
redwood-30b,eu-west1,H100-80G,fp16,512,85,180,650,6
```

ben: TL;DR — H100 has ~40-50% higher tokens/s on typical seq512 workloads, especially with fused kernels. A100 is fine for short seqs and is cheaper per-hour in our current cloud pricing. A10-like cards are only for low-cost burst pools.

eva: Note on kernels: we tested cutlass, fused-attn and a custom fused+kv-cache path. Fused-attn (+custom tiling) gave +15% tokens/s on H100 for seq>=256, but noticed a p95 tail when concurrency <6 (warmup/launch jitter). For int8 quant, kernel selection matters — int8 path used a different GEMM kernel which increased throughput but added ~5-10ms variance at p95.

infra-bot: perf-tests/1805246000 completed, artifacts: https://internal-ci/artifacts/1805246000 (charts + raw logs) :white_check_mark:

frank: For Dedicated capacity planning we should pick per-GPU concurrency that keeps p95 under our SLO (~200ms for short chat, ~500ms for longer streaming). Using the above, a reasonable starting target:
- H100 (eu-west1): concurrency target = 12 (int8), tokens/s ~1280 => 1 GPU supports ~1280 tokens/s. For steady-state 100k tokens/s demand that'd be ~79 GPUs + headroom.
- A100 (us-west1): concurrency target = 10 (int8), tokens/s ~980.

amy: Can we translate tokens/s -> user-concurrency (requests/s) assumption? We need that to size pools for customer SLAs. Example: avg request = 80 tokens, so tokens/s 1280 => 16 req/s per GPU. If target per-customer sustained req/s is 200 => ~13 GPUs for that customer (before headroom).

chao: Quick calc snippet I used:
```bash
# assume tokens_s, avg_tokens_per_request
avg_tokens=80
tokens_s=1280
req_s=$(echo "$tokens_s / $avg_tokens" | bc)
# -> 16 req/s per GPU
```

eva: Autoscale headroom: recommend 25-35% buffer for bursty chat traffic (our traces show 95th percentile burst ~1.3x sustained). For new model bring-up I'd bias to 30% until we have metrics for 2 weeks.

ben: ops note — if we choose H100-heavy pools, account for region quotas (eu-west1 H100 availability limited). Also mixing GPU types in a pool complicates routing and fallbacks. Prefer separate pools per GPU class.

frank: Proposed pool configs to start (can iterate after a week of telemetry):
- pool-redwood-30b-eu-h100-int8: target_per_gpu_concurrency=12, autoscale_buffer=30%, min=4, max=200
- pool-redwood-30b-us-a100-int8: target_per_gpu_concurrency=10, autoscale_buffer=30%, min=6, max=300
- pool-redwood-30b-burst-cost: A10G-int8, target_concurrency=4, autoscale_buffer=50%, min=0, max=50 (for low-priority/cheap bursts)

amy: I like that. Action items:
- chao: add the per-region quota check and estimate monthly hours for these pools (by EOD).
- eva: add kernel mapping + quant profile to the rollout config (so runtime picks int8 fused path by default in H100 pools).
- infra: create pools with the above defaults behind a canary rollout (50% traffic) and monitor p50/p95 and cost per 1M tokens.

chao: Will do. I already started a quota request in us-west for extra A100s.

ben: small caution — int8 quality regressions: run the eval suite on the same prompt set we use for quality/regression alerts before enabling int8 for prod. We've seen small BLEU/ROUGE shifts in earlier quant runs.

amy: Agreed. Eva or ML team run the evals and post signal before we flip int8 for customer-facing fixed pools. For canary we can keep fp16 fallback enabled.

frank: I'll draft the rollout runbook and include rollback triggers (p95 > 2x baseline, quality drop > 1.5% on eval).

amy: Thanks all — we'll reconvene in 48h after the first canary wave. :thumbsup:
